prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `Note`, `Folder`, and a `NotebookIndex` class. The class must provide:

- `addFolder(folder: Folder): void`
- `deleteFolder(folderId: string): boolean`
- `addNote(folderId: string, note: Note): void`
- `deleteNote(noteId: string): boolean`
- `listFolders(): Folder[]`
- `notesIn(folderId: string): Note[]`

A note has `id`, `folderId`, and `body`; a folder has `id`, `label`, and `notes`. IDs, labels, and note bodies must be nonblank and must not be normalized. Folder IDs and note IDs are globally unique. Initial notes supplied with a folder must refer to that folder. Adding a note requires its `folderId` to equal the destination ID. Duplicate or malformed data and unknown destinations must throw `RangeError`.

Deletion returns false when its target is absent. Deleting a folder also deletes its notes. Preserve folder and note insertion order. All input objects must be defensively copied, and every query must return deep copies so callers cannot mutate stored state.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
